goal: Generate a multi-style collage featuring the same Chinese woman as the sole subject, with variations in artistic style, the central box being the largest.

subject.description: The same East Asian woman, about 28 years old, with shoulder-length straight black hair, fine eyebrows, off-white cotton shirt, hands naturally crossed in front of her abdomen, expression calm with a slight smile. Changing hairstyle and shirt color is prohibited for cross-box recognition.
subject.consistency_rule: In the five frames, the facial proportions and clothing styles are consistent, with only the rendering methods differing.

layout.format: Central large square + small corner squares, overall set against a light beige-gray paper texture.
layout.label_position: Centered at the bottom edge of each grid
layout.label_design: 9pt monospaced uppercase English + Chinese subheading, black text on white background with rounded corners

panels.style: High resolution soft light studio photography, white background, discernible skin texture and fabric folds
panels.label: PHOTO · Portrait

panels.style: Modern Japanese anime cel shading, clear line art, flat coloring, blush lines
panels.label: ANIME · Japanese anime

panels.style: Freehand light ink wash with reserved white smoke effect, only the face slightly tinted with ochre.
panels.label: INK · Ink wash

panels.style: Classical oil painting, Rembrandt-style side light, deep brown background, visible thick brush strokes
panels.label: OIL · Oil painting

panels.style: Cyberpunk, neon magenta and electric cyan rim light, slight glitch textures and fine mesh HUD, only for atmosphere and not blocking the face
panels.label: CYBER · Cyber

global_constraints.background: The entire background has a uniform #F2EFE8 fine grain paper texture, with 10px light gray seams between small grids.
global_constraints.spacing: White seam anchoring to avoid unrelated background colors for each grid

must_keep: One glance in the five frames is of different styles from the same group rather than five individuals.
Cyborgs do not excessively add masks and prosthetics, keeping the face recognizable
Label does not obscure the center of facial features.
avoid: One section changes to male or children's clothing.
Ink wash style comic symbols appear in dialogue boxes.
The central square is too dark, drowning out the recognition anchor.
